Hi Jörg,

Thanks, that helps. Both are live in the store right now: the Harlo B1 (1.5 TH/s) is $99 and the Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10 TH/s) is $349, currently down from $449. Both ship with the plug matched to your German address.

I have passed your two choices to Georges and Abel so they can set the voucher up against them. They are back at their desks tomorrow from 10am Eastern, and the code will come to you as a reply here. I will not quote you a figure before they have fixed it, but the request is with them with the full history of this return behind it.

One thing worth knowing while you decide: the B1 is a genuinely nice little desk unit at 1.2 to 1.5 TH/s for about 22 to 31 watts, and the P2 at $349 is the better value per TH of the two.

Kind regards,
Sarah
